text: I don't think it's a wise idea for presidential candidates to appoint the members of his cabinet prospectively, or to suggest four people - indicate that one of them surely will be appointed
speaker: KENNEDY

text: This is a decision that the president of the United States must make
speaker: KENNEDY

text: The last candidate who indicated that he knew who his cabinet was going to be was Mr. Dewey in 1948
speaker: KENNEDY
